title: Adabana
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: After two killings in a small town, high schooler Mizuki Aikawa confesses to murdering her best friend Mako. Her public defender, Yutaka Tsuji, finds contradictions, and the story moves back and forth in time to reveal sexual exploitation by Mako's uncle, an overbearing mother and a cover-up. A three-volume psychological crime thriller with an unreliable narrator; Dark Horse lists it 18+.
life_message: Hidden abuse, family pressure and secrecy can destroy young lives; the truth deserves to be heard.
